scope: Public host API subsets only; not Private Android runtime support

apis.name: CreateFileW
apis.returns: Result<Handle>; INVALID_HANDLE on failure; success diagnostic 183 for existing OPEN_ALWAYS/CREATE_ALWAYS
limitations: No attributes/security/template/overlapped parameters; CREATE_ALWAYS requires write access
ASCII case folding only; strict absolute C/D paths, no dot normalization or NT paths
POSIX unlink rather than NT delete-pending; share checks within this instance only
Metadata access=0 still follows conservative file sharing checks; attribute sharing exemption not implemented

apis.name: ReadFile
apis.returns: Result<size_t>; EOF is success with zero bytes
limitations: Synchronous regular files only; host short reads returned; no overlapped I/O

apis.name: WriteFile
apis.returns: Result<size_t>; bytes written, including host short writes
limitations: Synchronous regular files only; host short writes returned

apis.name: SetFilePointerEx
apis.returns: Result<uint64_t>; new offset
limitations: POSIX signed off_t range; no unbuffered I/O; distances outside signed host range not supported

apis.name: GetFileSizeEx
apis.returns: Result<uint64_t>; regular file size
limitations: Only opened regular-file handles

apis.name: FlushFileBuffers
apis.returns: Error; adapter maps success to BOOL
limitations: Host fsync; no device/pipe/overlapped handles

apis.name: CloseHandle
apis.returns: Error; adapter maps success to BOOL
limitations: Only FileApi-owned file handles; borrowed CRT handle is not closable here

apis.name: DeleteFileW
apis.returns: Error; adapter maps success to BOOL
limitations: Immediate POSIX unlink, not NT delete-pending; no cross-context sharing

apis.name: CreateDirectoryW
apis.returns: Error; adapter maps success to BOOL
limitations: No recursive creation/security attributes; trailing separator accepted

apis.name: RemoveDirectoryW
apis.returns: Error; adapter maps success to BOOL
limitations: Empty directories only; no directory handles/delete-pending

apis.name: GetFileAttributesW
apis.returns: Result<uint32_t>; attributes; adapter supplies INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES on failure
limitations: READONLY mapped to host owner-write bit; no hidden/system/archive/timestamps

apis.name: MoveFileExW
apis.returns: Error; adapter maps success to BOOL
limitations: Regular files only; no cross-drive copy, reboot, directory move, or case-only rename
Legacy directory destination conflict reports 32; no global namespace lock against external writers

apis.name: _wopen
apis.returns: Result<int>; -1 on failure
limitations: Binary mode only; no pmode parameter/umask emulation; creation uses 0600
Descriptor owns borrowed Win32 handle; text/default modes explicitly rejected

apis.name: _read
apis.returns: Result<size_t>; adapter returns byte count or -1
limitations: Binary only; descriptor-local state

apis.name: _write
apis.returns: Result<size_t>; adapter returns byte count or -1
limitations: Binary only; append uses POSIX O_APPEND

apis.name: _close
apis.returns: Error; adapter returns 0 or -1
limitations: Owned descriptors only; double-close rejected

apis.name: _get_osfhandle
apis.returns: Result<Handle>; borrowed handle or INVALID_HANDLE
limitations: No ownership transfer; descriptor close invalidates borrowed handle

apis.name: RegOpenKeyExW
apis.returns: Result<RegistryHandle>; adapter returns LSTATUS and writes handle only on success
limitations: HKCU/HKLM only; ASCII folding, exact non-ASCII; no WOW64 views/links/ACLs
Empty predefined root returns original root; empty nonroot allocates new handle

apis.name: RegCreateKeyExW
apis.returns: Result<RegistryHandle>; optional disposition 1 new / 2 existing
limitations: Memory per virtual hive lifetime; no durable storage, volatile/link/backup options or security attributes
HKCU writable; virtual HKLM read-only unless configured explicitly; create checks hive policy not parent handle mask
Up to 32 components per call, 255 UTF-16 units per component; total depth capped at 512

apis.name: RegQueryValueExW
apis.returns: Error/LSTATUS; byte size and optional type; 234 with required size when too small
limitations: No expansion, terminator synthesis, or type coercion; copied raw bytes
Adapter checks reserved NULL; no predefined performance hives

apis.name: RegSetValueExW
apis.returns: Error/LSTATUS; deep copy of exactly cbData bytes
limitations: DWORD/QWORD are caller-supplied little-endian 4/8-byte data; raw malformed payloads not repaired
String callers supply UTF-16LE bytes including terminators; query does not guarantee termination
Adapter checks Reserved=0; no host registry writes

apis.name: RegCloseKey
apis.returns: Error/LSTATUS; 0 on close or supported predefined hive
limitations: Only handles allocated by this context and two supported predefined roots

apis.name: RegDeleteValueW
apis.returns: Error/LSTATUS; delete a named or default in-memory value
limitations: No persistent registry; HKLM writable only by explicitly authorized virtual hive policy
host_dependencies: C++17 in-memory RegistryApi; no Windows SDK, no host OS registry

apis.name: RegDeleteKeyW
apis.reason: No public module implementation; no stub/success result

apis.name: RegEnumKeyExW
apis.returns: Result<u16string> immediate subkey snapshot; ABI adapter handles caller buffer sizes
limitations: ASCII-only case folding; deterministic lexical host order, not native Windows storage enumeration order
host_dependencies: C++17 in-memory RegistryApi; no Windows SDK, no host OS registry

apis.name: RegEnumValueW
apis.returns: Result<RegistryValueRecord> name/type/deep-copied bytes; adapter handles buffer negotiation
limitations: Snapshot result; no Windows-compatible buffer negotiation inside host C++ method
host_dependencies: C++17 in-memory RegistryApi; no Windows SDK, no host OS registry
